items.markdown:
![Thai Fried Chicken Recipe - Hot Thai Kitchen](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280947-1672-0139-0000-38da5a48e473:6)
Hat Yai fried chicken is `a famous southern Thai street food specialty known for its crispy skin, tender meat, and aromatic garlic-and-spice profile` . It is defined by a light rice flour crust and a heavy topping of golden, sweet fried shallots.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2QrYTGD7hNA) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2QrYTGD7hNA)[[2]](https://www.dontgobaconmyheart.co.uk/thai-fried-chicken/)[[3]](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/southern-thai-fried-chicken-gai-tod-hat-yai)[[4]](https://www.gousto.co.uk/cookbook/recipes/thai-style-hat-yai-garlic-fried-chicken)[[5]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/hat-yai-fried-chicken/)

Key Characteristics and Ingredients

- **The Marinade:** A pounded paste of garlic, white/black peppercorns, and cilantro roots or stems mixed with light soy sauce, fish sauce, and a touch of sugar. Water is often added to help the seasoning penetrate the chicken meat.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2QrYTGD7hNA) 
- **The Coating:** A thin, crisp layer made using rice flour rather than a thick, batter-heavy American crust.
- **The Shallots:** Thinly sliced red shallots salted, dried, and deep-fried separately on low heat until crunchy. They are piled in abundance over the finished chicken.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tFYTGAbkD1g&t=47) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tFYTGAbkD1g&t=47)
- **The Accompaniments:** Traditionally served hot alongside sticky rice (glutinous rice) and a side of sweet chili dipping sauce.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tFYTGAbkD1g&t=47) 

For a visual guide on how to prep, coat, and fry the chicken to get the crispy skin and golden color just right:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRL7t3g5BbnIFzFOM83e5foa4A_yxoH7v7ZQoE__AVOOG52hrc4)
